title: Voronoi nearest-point interaction
intent: Partition automobile weight and fuel-economy observations into nearest-point regions and reveal the closest car.

source.title: Observable Plot Voronoi and pointer interactions

ai.create: Create a cylinder-colored Voronoi scatterplot from automobile weight and fuel economy with native two-dimensional nearest-car tooltips. Use Plot's voronoi and pointer primitives and granular d3-delaunay at the TanStack composition boundary.
ai.maintain: Change the selected cars while retaining bounded cells, source car identity, matching color domains, typed tooltip rows, responsive recomputation, and keyboard focus without importing spatial code into the shared renderer.
